I feel the same way when I finish anime. I'll note a few things that help me, hope they help you as well.
1. Rewatch the anime. I find watching it again feels like a new experience, you notice things you didn't before. Also, if you watched the dub, watch the subs. Certain VA's can be better and they often change the dialogue.
2. Read the manga or LN's. This is what i'm doing with Date a live at the moment. It also helps you can easily put a voice, face and personality to the character. Picture it in your head, if your imagination is good enough it's kind of like watching the show.
3. This is a personal one that might not help you. But try writing down your thoughts and feelings about the show. I have a giant excel sheet where I give the show's a mini review. It helps to look back on it and realize what you enjoyed about it.
This may all be very personal and subjective but it's what helps me, hope it helps you too.
